title: Mixing: Move Over Ms L, Steel And Glass, Beef Jerky, Nobody Loves You (When You’re Down And Out) by John Lennon | 1974
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producer: John Lennon

A mixing session for John Lennon’s Walls And Bridges album was held on 27 August 1974.

Three album tracks were mixed in stereo: ‘Steel And Glass’, ‘Beef Jerky’, and ‘Nobody Loves You (When You’re Down And Out)’, plus the non-album b-side ‘Move Over Ms L’.
